about: Library catalogue of `drag-lint sbom`: which supplier, name, version and licence a group of units carries in the CycloneDX document.
EDIT THIS FILE (or pass your own with --catalogue). The first row that matches wins, so put the narrower row first.
paths: file masks (* and ?), case-insensitive, matched anywhere in the full path of a unit's source file.

units: unit-name patterns (a trailing * = prefix, else the whole name); consulted ONLY for a unit that has no source in any index. Such a match is name-only evidence and the component says so (drag-lint:attribution = unit-name).
version: a fixed version text. versionFromPath: a regular expression whose first group is the version, read from the unit paths (used when version is absent; two different results = no version).
licenseId: an SPDX licence id. licenseExpression: an SPDX expression. licenseName: free text for a licence SPDX does not list. Give one of the three.
firstParty: true folds the matching units into the application itself (your own shared source outside the project folder).
A unit group no row matches is still listed, with the supplier 'unknown supplier'. Check the versions and licences against what you actually ship.
